reviews.text:
5 Stars: Absolute Perfection! A Masterpiece of Design and Execution.

I couldn't be happier with my new composite patio deck, which was designed and installed by the incredible team at DeckMasters. From the initial concept to the final installation, everything went exactly as planned.

The design phase was fantastic. Blake took our vision and elevated it, presenting my wife and I with a stunning chevron pattern for the floor that completely transformed the look of our yard.

The execution was just as impressive. Eric and Robert managed the project flawlessly, ensuring every step of the installation was on schedule and perfectly to spec. And Marco is truly a master of carpentry—watching him install the deck was amazing! The entire structure came together with the precision of a puzzle, fitted together to perfection.

The entire process was smooth, finished on time, and completely stress-free. I am extremely grateful for the professionalism and expertise demonstrated by every single person on the DeckMasters team. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: QuietOne

reviews.text:
My child bride and I enjoyed being in the backyard more than just about any other place on earth.  Though we had only a poured concrete patio (that came with the house) and a table and chairs set with adjustable umbrella, we had talked for years about adding an actual covered deck for the nirvana of a totally weatherproof way of being outside.

As a retirement gift to ourselves, we decided to pursue the backyard project of our dreams.  I researched deck and cover building companies on Google and Deck Masters came up at or near the top.  I made the call and we scheduled an appointment.  Blake came out and we spent some time going over exactly what we wanted, and how we were going to use it.  He asked questions, offered suggestions, went over all the options, and figured a price.

Honestly, the price was higher than we had planned on.  But figuring the use we were sure we would get out of it, and the years we plan on being in our home, we could justify the cost as an investment rather than an expense.  We pulled the trigger and scheduled some other needed improvements and updates in order to kill a few birds with one stone.

The hardest part was waiting.  Blake said it would be about six weeks.  We scheduled all the other aspects of the project in a sequential order that made sense so we’d be ready when the deck builders showed up.

So much for the best laid plans.  Due to weather, other projects, and the home improvement gods laughing at our efforts, we had crews stacked on top of each other.  Nobody complained and everyone played well with others.  The Deck Master crew was great.  They were craftsmen who knew what they were doing, took their time, and followed through with exactly what we wanted.

We’d been told it would take ten days to two weeks and the job was completed in half that time.  Eric checked on the job during construction and addressed any questions or concerns we may have had during the process.  It matched exactly the vision we had for the backyard when completed.

We couldn’t be happier with the end result, and recommend Deck Masters for whatever project you might be considering to give your home the outdoor space you might be dreaming of.
reviews.author: Robin Wetterling

reviews.text:
Beautiful work. Great team to work with.
Blake Stewart took my ideas, and brought them to life. Eric Snyder oversaw the construction, and kept us informed about details all the way through project completion. Couldn’t be happier with the results. Took an ubiquitous 10x10 cement slab, and turned it into a beautiful space to enjoy, and entertain friends and family.
reviews.author: Jamie Bain

reviews.text: We are thrilled with our new, badly needed, patio cover! It is beautiful and really improved the amount of shade in our backyard. I got several bids before we chose DeckMasters.
reviews.author: Terry Martin

reviews.text: Here’s our story on DeckMasters. We 1st used them for a pergola 22 years ago and we needed to replace it after several hail storms. We called 2 places. When Blake came to see us he could have (and perhaps should have) upsold us, but he didn’t.  When Robert came to remove the old structure he asked me “why don’t you put up a covered structure it would give you more usage?”I told him it would cost too much! But he convinced me and we got a quote. It was hard to ignore the quote so we went for it. During construction there were two times when we were unhappy. Eric not only took the time to explain but instead of nickeling and diming us took care of them.  Our total experience with them was great and now we have a covered cedar area that is awesome!  These guys stand behind what they do, they want customers to leave with a great experience. They walk the talk. My wife Sabrina is one of the top 1% of Realtors in the DFW area and DeckMasters is on her list of contractors that actually deliver and “walk the talk.” Thank you!
reviews.author: Anicetus Fernando

reviews.text:
My daughter had DeckMasters redo her deck and patio. They did such a great job that we had them do ours even though we live an hour away.
Blake came down , measured and discussed what we would like. He asked us all kinds of questions and gave us a quote on the spot. Eric was project manager and did a great job of communicating with us on progress and any potential changes to the plan. The concrete crew and carpenters were very respectful of our property and cleaned up daily.
We are thinking of a gazebo in the future, I will call only DeckMasters!
reviews.author: Aussie Dad

reviews.text: Our extended back patio looks amazing!! Eric and his team did a phenomenal job. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Stephanie Wolf

reviews.text: After 15 years in our house we finally added a patio cover! We have a fully functional outdoor living space & cannot be more thrilled! With the sun setting in our backyard we never thought we'd be able to enjoy it, but we do now!! An extra bonus, it will save on our electric bill. Pictures do not do it justice. It is ABSOLUTELY beautiful!!
reviews.author: Kristi Porter

data.summary: The provided Google reviews appear authentic and detailed, but the analysis is limited by a strategic sample that excludes all negative and neutral reviews. The substantial rating discrepancy with Yelp (3.2) indicates the full picture of customer experience is not represented. The long business history and specific details in positive reviews are strong authentic signals.
fake_signals: Google sample shows only 5-star reviews, no negative or mixed reviews provided
Some Google reviews use overly enthusiastic, generic language (e.g., 'Absolute Perfection! A Masterpiece')

positive_evidence: Customer returned after 22 years for a replacement, indicating long-term satisfaction

authentic_signals: Specific employee names mentioned (Blake, Eric, Robert)
Detailed project descriptions (chevron pattern, replacing old pergola, converting concrete slab)
Varied writing styles and personal stories (retirement gift, daughter's referral)
Company has been in business for 28 years
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant rating gap between Google (4.4) and Yelp (3.2). Google reviews are uniformly positive (5-star sample), while Yelp's lower rating suggests a mix of experiences not captured in the provided Google sample.
